actions.text: PR #2 merged — thank you! Next: review PR #3 (the A1+A2 instrument; zero file overlap with your realism branch, either merge order works).

Two contract calls still open: lighting.warmth label/formula inversion; coupled-vars notes.
M2 Mac smoke test: build RoomGen ▸ Build macOS Application on a lab MacBook, launch (right-click → Open), walk the pair, report. Unlocks Macs for everyone.
Fresh-clone check per GETTING_STARTED.md; expect all tests green.
Pick the demo experiment (ceiling pair is flagship), write the rating prompt + trials config + hypothesis. A1 has shipped — the operator studio is ready to author through.
Run one session as operator, sit as participant in another's. Target 5+ clean CSVs. Report anything confusing — that's the feedback we can't generate.
Call the M2 fidelity-gate verdict on the renders (proposed: conditional pass); then own the demo-day evidence pack.
A1 + A2 SHIPPED (PR #3) and live-verified — including a full participant session producing a clean CSV.
Now: verify the built participant app renders → publish the download for the team run; wire the operator's Publish button to the study JSON the participant app loads.
